title: The Prismatic Understory Where Hues Grow Wild

features.name: dispersal-pool
features.desc-on-touch: light breaks here into its component hues; the longer you look, the more colors separate into their own grammars, each one arguing what undergrowth means

features.name: the-prisming-arch
features.desc-on-touch: vegetation creates refractions here; each plant holds a different fraction of light and refuses to share its colour with the others

features.name: hue-stones
features.desc-on-touch: stones arranged in order of colour; the order keeps changing when you turn away. you never catch the moment of rearrangement

features.name: the-painted-creature
features.desc-on-touch: something moves through undergrowth leaving trails of colour that smell like nothing you've encountered; its form follows the hues it leaves, not the hues following it

features.name: color-strata
features.desc-on-touch: things stack here sorted by hue, not by weight: purple above magenta above cyan; the physics has learned a different hierarchy than gravity allows

inscription: color learned to speak before the forest learned its own name
